```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(gbm)
df <- read_csv("../data/bc_full_factorial_dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
factors <- c("pH", "Temp_C", "RPM", "Inoculum_pct", "Sugar_gL")
cond_means <- df %>% group_by(across(all_of(factors))) %>%
  summarise(mean_yield = mean(BC_yield_gL), .groups = "drop")
set.seed(42)
train_idx <- createDataPartition(cond_means$mean_yield, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train <- cond_means[train_idx, ]; test <- cond_means[-train_idx, ]
```

## Exercise 1 — Tune Random Forest
```{r ex1, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
results <- data.frame()
for (mtry_val in 1:5) {
  set.seed(42)
  rf <- randomForest(mean_yield ~ ., data = train, ntree = 500, mtry = mtry_val)
  pred <- predict(rf, newdata = test)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((test$mean_yield - pred)^2))
  results <- rbind(results, data.frame(mtry = mtry_val, RMSE = rmse, OOB_error = rf$mse[500]))
}
ggplot(results, aes(x = mtry, y = RMSE)) + geom_line(colour = "forestgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "RF: RMSE vs mtry")
```

## Exercise 2 — Tune GBM
```{r ex2}
results2 <- data.frame()
for (sh in c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2)) {
  for (depth in c(2, 4, 6)) {
    set.seed(42)
    g <- gbm(mean_yield ~ ., data = train, distribution = "gaussian",
             n.trees = 500, interaction.depth = depth, shrinkage = sh)
    p <- predict(g, newdata = test, n.trees = 500)
    results2 <- rbind(results2, data.frame(shrinkage = sh, depth = depth,
                                           RMSE = sqrt(mean((test$mean_yield - p)^2))))
  }
}
results2 %>% arrange(RMSE) %>% head(5) %>% print()
```

## Exercise 3
```{r ex3, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
rf <- randomForest(mean_yield ~ ., data = train, ntree = 500, mtry = 3)
gb <- gbm(mean_yield ~ ., data = train, distribution = "gaussian", n.trees = 500,
          interaction.depth = 4, shrinkage = 0.1)
df_coded <- cond_means
low <- c(4,25,50,5,20); high <- c(6,35,200,15,60); names(low) <- names(high) <- factors
for (f in factors) df_coded[[paste0(f,"_coded")]] <- 2*(cond_means[[f]]-low[f])/(high[f]-low[f])-1
rsm <- lm(mean_yield ~ pH_coded + Temp_C_coded + RPM_coded + Inoculum_pct_coded + Sugar_gL_coded +
  pH_coded:Temp_C_coded + Sugar_gL_coded:RPM_coded +
  I(pH_coded^2) + I(Temp_C_coded^2) + I(RPM_coded^2) + I(Inoculum_pct_coded^2) + I(Sugar_gL_coded^2), data = df_coded)
test_coded <- test; for (f in factors) test_coded[[paste0(f,"_coded")]] <- 2*(test[[f]]-low[f])/(high[f]-low[f])-1

comp <- tibble(
  Actual = rep(test$mean_yield, 3),
  Predicted = c(predict(rsm, test_coded), predict(rf, test), predict(gb, test, n.trees = 500)),
  Model = rep(c("RSM", "RF", "GBM"), each = nrow(test))
)
ggplot(comp, aes(x = Actual, y = Predicted, colour = Model)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + geom_abline(linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Model) + theme_minimal() + labs(title = "Observed vs Predicted")
```
